verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a government web portal like the Guichet unique, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented telemetry, analytics or cookie opt-out. The only privacy item (docs-16) covers anonymizing published filings and personal data in the registry, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
